definition: I. [ בָּדַד ] verb be separate, isolated (Arabic cause to withdraw ; II. separate, disunite , Gen 11:8 Saad ; IV. divide into parts ; x. go alone, act independently ), only Participle בּוֺדֵד Isa 14:31 (of straggler in army), Hos 8:9 פֶּרֶא בוֺדֵד לוֺ a wild-ass (simile of Ephraim) going alone for itself (i.e. willfully: see below לְ ), Ps 102:8 (of bird sitting solitarily).
